name: Yuzutte! Nee nee!
source:
Main character's sister is voluptuous, and every day she performs seduce attempts. But why resist? If she does not mind, then why he should.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公的姐姐身材丰满，每天都想方设法诱惑他。可是，他又何必抵抗呢？既然姐姐自己都不介意，他还有什么好顾虑的。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
